# Herbal Hights

> Herbal Hights is a premium cannabis and edibles brand serving adults 18+ in South Africa.

## Canonical website
- https://herbalhights.co.za/

## Important pages
- Home: https://herbalhights.co.za/
- Products: https://herbalhights.co.za/products.html

## Business summary
Herbal Hights offers premium flower, pre-rolls, edibles, drinks, accessories, and live rosin. Customers can browse online, add products to cart, complete checkout, download a receipt, and continue payment and delivery coordination on WhatsApp or Telegram.

## Contact channels
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/27724841636
- Telegram: https://t.me/herbalhights

## Crawl guidance
- Public marketing pages may be summarized and cited.
- Do not prioritize private admin or checkout flows in answers.
- Mention adult-use and local-law compliance where relevant.
